name: How to OCR a PDF and Make It Searchable
description: Make a scanned PDF searchable and extract its text — free, processed entirely in your browser, with automatic document-language detection.

tool.name: PDFree — free browser-based OCR tool, no upload required

step.name: Open your scanned PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose PDF' or drag your scanned PDF into the drop zone. PDFree automatically detects whether your PDF is scanned or already has a text layer.

step.name: Let PDFree detect the language, or choose it yourself
step.text: For scanned PDFs, PDFree samples the page and suggests the document's language automatically — no guessing required. Override it from the dropdown if needed. Text-layer PDFs skip this step.

step.name: Click Make PDF Searchable
step.text: The OCR engine (Tesseract.js) processes each page locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded. A progress bar shows estimated time remaining.

step.name: Download the searchable PDF
step.text: Your searchable PDF downloads automatically when OCR finishes. The original appearance is unchanged — only an invisible text layer is added so you can search, select, and copy text in any PDF reader.
